name: product-squad
description: Agentic dev OS for one-person teams: a product/scoping cluster (mission → why → vet → shape → experience → owit → elon → spec) + a visual fidelity ladder (sketch → wireframe → mockup → prototype → handoff), bridged by /decompose and shipped via /gh-issue + 4 swappable brand-archetype flavors (linear, apple, airbnb, uber). Plus 31 command skills: UI audits (a11y, brand-audit, crap, imagine, qa, ux-design), harness/context audits (harness-audit, context-diet, usage-audit), eng tighteners (build, eng-deep-dive, eng-review, investigate, pm, verify, ship, pr-review), spec contracts (flow, api), brand & naming (namer, domain-check), product (mochary), safety (guard), and session hygiene (checkpoint, debrief, list-capabilities, pickup, retro, sessions, sync-repos, todo).
